_comment: The app's own changelog — the source of truth for the 'What's New' dialog
shown once after an update, and for Settings > About > Full changelog.
Newest release FIRST. Every entry needs a `version` (bare semver, no
leading v), a `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and a `highlights` map of locale -> list
of one-line strings. `en` is required; any locale that is missing falls
back to it, so a release can ship translated late without breaking.
Add the entry for a release BEFORE tagging it:
CI enforces this — see 'Verify changelog has an entry for the tag' in

en: A "What's New" summary appears once after each update, and Settings now has a full changelog going back to 1.0.
Release tracks show each song's length, parts progress (click it to manage parts) and your notes, with the release's total running time at the bottom.
A song's length is read from its preview song automatically, or can be typed on the project page.
A release's tracks can also be viewed as a sortable table.
Creating a release offers to reuse a selected track's cover art as the release artwork.
Cover art shows in the mobile player, the mini player and the lock-screen notification.
Only one song on a release plays at a time, and audio files show their length before you press play.
Player shortcuts: Ctrl+scroll (⌘+scroll on macOS) changes the volume, M toggles mono, and the volume is remembered.
Project folders can be switched off instead of removed — nothing is deleted — and the project counts now match the list.
Tasks tab: tasks are ticked off with the checkbox only, and a ticked task stays visible with an Undo button until you leave the tab.
Breadcrumbs in the title bar show where you are and take you back in one click.
Cover art and accent colours fade in from the right of the projects list, and card covers fade at the bottom so their buttons stay visible.
pt: Um resumo de "Novidades" aparece uma vez após cada atualização, e as Configurações agora têm o changelog completo desde a versão 1.0.
As faixas de um lançamento mostram a duração de cada música, o progresso das partes (clique para gerenciá-las) e suas anotações, com a duração total no final.
A duração de uma música é lida automaticamente da prévia, ou pode ser digitada na página do projeto.
As faixas de um lançamento também podem ser vistas em uma tabela ordenável.
Ao criar um lançamento, o app oferece reaproveitar a capa de uma faixa selecionada.
As capas aparecem no player mobile, no mini player e na notificação da tela de bloqueio.
Só uma música de um lançamento toca por vez, e os arquivos de áudio mostram a duração antes de dar play.
Atalhos do player: Ctrl+rolagem (⌘+rolagem no macOS) altera o volume, M alterna o mono, e o volume fica salvo.
Pastas de projetos podem ser desativadas em vez de removidas — nada é apagado — e a contagem de projetos agora bate com a lista.
Aba Tarefas: as tarefas só são concluídas pela caixa de seleção, e uma tarefa concluída continua visível com um botão Desfazer até você sair da aba.
Um caminho de navegação na barra de título mostra onde você está e volta com um clique.
Capas e cores de destaque surgem pela direita na lista de projetos, e as capas dos cards esmaecem embaixo para os botões ficarem visíveis.
es: Tras cada actualización aparece una vez un resumen de "Novedades", y Ajustes incluye ahora el changelog completo desde la 1.0.
Las pistas de un lanzamiento muestran la duración de cada canción, el progreso de sus partes (haz clic para gestionarlas) y tus notas, con la duración total al final.
La duración de una canción se lee automáticamente de su vista previa, o se puede escribir en la página del proyecto.
Las pistas de un lanzamiento también se pueden ver en una tabla ordenable.
Al crear un lanzamiento, se ofrece reutilizar la portada de una pista seleccionada.
Las portadas se muestran en el reproductor móvil, el minirreproductor y la notificación de la pantalla de bloqueo.
Solo suena una canción de un lanzamiento a la vez, y los archivos de audio muestran su duración antes de reproducirlos.
Atajos del reproductor: Ctrl+rueda (⌘+rueda en macOS) cambia el volumen, M alterna mono y el volumen se recuerda.
Las carpetas de proyectos se pueden desactivar en lugar de eliminar —no se borra nada— y el recuento de proyectos coincide ahora con la lista.
Pestaña Tareas: las tareas solo se marcan con la casilla, y una tarea marcada sigue visible con un botón Deshacer hasta que sales de la pestaña.
Una ruta de navegación en la barra de título muestra dónde estás y te devuelve con un clic.
Las portadas y los colores de acento aparecen desde la derecha en la lista de proyectos, y las portadas de las tarjetas se difuminan abajo para que sus botones se vean.
fr: Un résumé « Nouveautés » s'affiche une fois après chaque mise à jour, et les Paramètres contiennent désormais le journal complet depuis la 1.0.
Les pistes d'une sortie affichent la durée de chaque morceau, l'avancement de ses parties (cliquez pour les gérer) et vos notes, avec la durée totale en bas.
La durée d'un morceau est lue automatiquement depuis son aperçu, ou peut être saisie sur la page du projet.
Les pistes d'une sortie peuvent aussi s'afficher dans un tableau triable.
À la création d'une sortie, l'app propose de réutiliser la pochette d'une piste sélectionnée.
Les pochettes apparaissent dans le lecteur mobile, le mini-lecteur et la notification de l'écran de verrouillage.
Un seul morceau d'une sortie joue à la fois, et les fichiers audio affichent leur durée avant la lecture.
Raccourcis du lecteur : Ctrl+molette (⌘+molette sur macOS) règle le volume, M bascule en mono, et le volume est mémorisé.
Les dossiers de projets peuvent être désactivés plutôt que supprimés — rien n'est effacé — et le nombre de projets correspond désormais à la liste.
Onglet Tâches : une tâche ne se coche qu'avec sa case, et une tâche cochée reste visible avec un bouton Annuler jusqu'à ce que vous quittiez l'onglet.
Un fil d'Ariane dans la barre de titre indique où vous êtes et vous ramène en un clic.
Pochettes et couleurs d'accent apparaissent en fondu par la droite dans la liste des projets, et les pochettes des cartes s'estompent en bas pour laisser voir leurs boutons.
de: Nach jedem Update erscheint einmalig eine „Neuigkeiten“-Übersicht, und die Einstellungen enthalten jetzt das vollständige Changelog seit 1.0.
Die Titel eines Releases zeigen Länge, Fortschritt der Parts (zum Verwalten anklicken) und Ihre Notizen, mit der Gesamtlaufzeit unten.
Die Länge eines Songs wird automatisch aus dem Vorschausong gelesen oder lässt sich auf der Projektseite eingeben.
Die Titel eines Releases lassen sich auch als sortierbare Tabelle anzeigen.
Beim Erstellen eines Releases wird angeboten, das Cover eines ausgewählten Titels zu übernehmen.
Cover erscheinen im Mobil-Player, im Mini-Player und in der Sperrbildschirm-Benachrichtigung.
Von einem Release spielt immer nur ein Song gleichzeitig, und Audiodateien zeigen ihre Länge schon vor der Wiedergabe.
Player-Kürzel: Strg+Mausrad (⌘+Mausrad unter macOS) ändert die Lautstärke, M schaltet Mono um, und die Lautstärke wird gespeichert.
Projektordner können abgeschaltet statt entfernt werden — nichts wird gelöscht — und die Projektanzahl stimmt jetzt mit der Liste überein.
Aufgaben-Tab: Aufgaben werden nur über das Kontrollkästchen abgehakt, und eine abgehakte Aufgabe bleibt mit Rückgängig-Schaltfläche sichtbar, bis Sie den Tab verlassen.
Eine Brotkrumen-Navigation in der Titelleiste zeigt, wo Sie sind, und führt mit einem Klick zurück.
Cover und Akzentfarben blenden in der Projektliste von rechts ein, und Karten-Cover blenden unten aus, damit ihre Schaltflächen sichtbar bleiben.
it: Dopo ogni aggiornamento compare una volta un riepilogo "Novità", e le Impostazioni ora contengono il changelog completo dalla 1.0.
Le tracce di una pubblicazione mostrano la durata di ogni brano, l'avanzamento delle parti (clicca per gestirle) e le tue note, con la durata totale in fondo.
La durata di un brano viene letta automaticamente dall'anteprima, oppure si può inserire nella pagina del progetto.
Le tracce di una pubblicazione si possono vedere anche in una tabella ordinabile.
Creando una pubblicazione, l'app propone di riusare la copertina di una traccia selezionata.
Le copertine compaiono nel player mobile, nel mini player e nella notifica della schermata di blocco.
Suona un solo brano di una pubblicazione alla volta, e i file audio mostrano la durata prima della riproduzione.
Scorciatoie del player: Ctrl+rotellina (⌘+rotellina su macOS) regola il volume, M attiva/disattiva il mono, e il volume viene ricordato.
Le cartelle dei progetti si possono disattivare invece di rimuoverle — non si elimina nulla — e il conteggio dei progetti ora corrisponde alla lista.
Scheda Attività: le attività si spuntano solo dalla casella, e un'attività spuntata resta visibile con un pulsante Annulla finché non lasci la scheda.
Un percorso di navigazione nella barra del titolo mostra dove ti trovi e ti riporta indietro con un clic.
Copertine e colori d'accento compaiono in dissolvenza da destra nella lista dei progetti, e le copertine delle schede sfumano in basso per lasciare visibili i pulsanti.
ru: После каждого обновления один раз показывается сводка «Что нового», а в Настройках теперь есть полный список изменений начиная с 1.0.
Треки релиза показывают длительность каждой песни, прогресс партий (нажмите, чтобы управлять ими) и ваши заметки, а внизу — общую длительность.
Длительность песни автоматически берётся из превью или вводится на странице проекта.
Треки релиза можно также просматривать в сортируемой таблице.
При создании релиза предлагается использовать обложку выбранного трека.
Обложки отображаются в мобильном плеере, мини-плеере и уведомлении на экране блокировки.
Из треков релиза одновременно играет только один, а аудиофайлы показывают длительность ещё до воспроизведения.
Горячие клавиши плеера: Ctrl+колесо (⌘+колесо на macOS) меняет громкость, M включает моно, а громкость запоминается.
Папки проектов можно отключить вместо удаления — ничего не стирается, — а число проектов теперь совпадает со списком.
Вкладка «Задачи»: задача отмечается только флажком, а отмеченная задача остаётся видна с кнопкой «Отменить», пока вы не покинете вкладку.
«Хлебные крошки» в заголовке окна показывают, где вы находитесь, и возвращают одним щелчком.
Обложки и акцентные цвета плавно появляются справа в списке проектов, а обложки карточек снизу растворяются, чтобы были видны кнопки.
ja: アップデート後に「新着情報」の概要が一度だけ表示され、設定には 1.0 以降の全変更履歴が載るようになりました。
リリースのトラックに各曲の長さ、パートの進捗（クリックで管理）、メモが表示され、下部に合計時間が表示されます。
曲の長さはプレビュー曲から自動で読み取られ、プロジェクトページで入力することもできます。
リリースのトラックは並べ替え可能なテーブルでも表示できます。
リリース作成時に、選択したトラックのカバーアートを使うか尋ねます。
カバーアートがモバイルプレーヤー、ミニプレーヤー、ロック画面の通知に表示されます。
リリース内の曲は一度に1曲だけ再生され、音声ファイルは再生前から長さが表示されます。
プレーヤーのショートカット：Ctrl+スクロール（macOS では ⌘+スクロール）で音量、M でモノラル切り替え。音量は記憶されます。
プロジェクトフォルダーは削除せずに無効化できます（何も消えません）。プロジェクト数もリストと一致するようになりました。
タスクタブ：タスクはチェックボックスでのみ完了になり、完了したタスクはタブを離れるまで「元に戻す」ボタン付きで表示されます。
タイトルバーのパンくずリストで現在地がわかり、ワンクリックで戻れます。
プロジェクト一覧ではカバーアートとアクセントカラーが右からフェードインし、カードのカバーは下部がフェードしてボタンが見やすくなりました。
zh: 每次更新后会显示一次“新增功能”摘要，“设置”中现在有自 1.0 以来的完整更新日志。
发行的曲目会显示每首歌的时长、声部进度（点击可管理）和你的备注，底部显示总时长。
歌曲时长会自动从预览歌曲读取，也可以在项目页面手动输入。
发行的曲目也可以用可排序的表格查看。
创建发行时，可选择沿用所选曲目的封面。
封面会显示在移动播放器、迷你播放器和锁屏通知中。
同一发行中一次只播放一首歌，音频文件在播放前就会显示时长。
播放器快捷键：Ctrl+滚轮（macOS 为 ⌘+滚轮）调整音量，M 切换单声道，音量会被记住。
项目文件夹可以停用而不必移除——不会删除任何内容——项目数量现在与列表一致。
任务标签页：只能通过复选框完成任务，已完成的任务会带着“撤销”按钮保持可见，直到你离开该标签页。
标题栏中的导航路径会显示当前位置，一键即可返回。
项目列表中的封面和强调色从右侧渐入，卡片封面底部渐隐，让按钮保持可见。

en: Parts & performers — track a song part by part (instrument, performer, take status), in a full workspace page with filters, bulk actions and reorder, plus reusable part templates and CSV/Excel export & re-import.
REAPER markers and regions — extracted from the project file and turned into a clickable table of contents; tapping one seeks the preview player.
Logic Pro & LUNA finally behave — launching, "Open folder" and pending-folder resolution all work for package-bundle projects, and Logic projects now yield BPM, key and app version.

DAW Locations on every desktop platform — Windows and macOS get the executable override that was Linux-only, and a DAW can now hold several locations (e.g. two Ableton versions) with a picker at launch.
Redesigned preview waveform — a peak/RMS bar rendering with real MP3 decoding instead of a header estimate, optional stereo lanes, and a Classic style kept as an option.
Search that narrows as you type — substring matching first, with a far stricter fuzzy fallback, and DAW project notes are now searchable.
Sectioned project detail layout — an optional left-rail layout for the long detail page, matching Settings.
Hide DAW-generated date stamps in project names (new setting).
"Find automatically" when a preview song is missing — clears the dead reference and re-runs mixdown detection. Desktop only, where detection actually runs.

iOS now matches Android for preview-song sharing and background audio: audio is transcoded to AAC/.m4a via AVAssetExportSession, and playback continues with lock-screen controls when the app loses focus.
Mobile long-press opens an action sheet (Play / Share / Details / Select) instead of jumping straight into multi-select. Once selecting, long-press is a plain toggle again.

BPM and key are edited on the detail page, not inline in the grid. Inline editing put a bordered text field inside the cell — the source of the stray "selected" highlight — and drag-selection no longer paints a range.
The title bar version string drops its leading v.
Android download is roughly half the size: a debug arm64 APK goes from 228.5 MB to 112.7 MB.
Android transcoding uses the platform's own MediaCodec via a ~200-line Kotlin converter instead of a bundled ffmpeg plugin.

Added a Cancel button while an update is fetching, downloading, or verifying; a failed or cancelled update now always cleans up its partial download instead of leaving a stray file next to the running AppImage.
Update failures now show a friendly message with an expandable "Error Details" section (with a copy button) and a button to open a pre-filled GitHub issue, instead of dumping the raw exception.

Fixed Share Diagnostic Log doing nothing on Linux (share_plus has no file-sharing implementation there) and popping a broken native dialog on Windows (the share flyout fails inside its own UI for an unpackaged build).
Added a Clear Diagnostic Log action and an Enable Diagnostic Logging toggle — logging is now off by default (opt-in) instead of always on.

Redesigned per-folder Scan Mode selection: it's now a compact inline control on each folder row instead of a separate card whose full mockup preview was duplicated for every folder added. The Flat vs.
"Report an Issue" now opens a structured GitHub issue form (bug/feature/other, repro steps, app version, OS, DAW, diagnostic log pointer) directly, instead of a blank issue page.
The License button now opens a dialog rendering the bundled LICENSE file in-app instead of sending users to GitHub.
Redesigned the Session Mode selector as a vertical list of icon + label + description rows, replacing side-by-side cards that used fabricated preview mockups.
Work session reminder controls are now disabled (with an explanatory hint) when Session Mode is off, since reminders only fire for projects subscribed via Session Mode.
Added a Send Test Notification button, available in every build/distribution channel (not just debug), to verify notification delivery across desktop packaging targets.
Fixed cramped padding on the Check Now button.
Added Zrythm (.zpj) DAW support.
Packaged a Linux AppImage as a third distribution channel alongside the tarball and Flatpak.
Deep Scan now shows real progress ("Loading project X of Y") instead of a spinner, and its confirmation dialog links to the Metadata Extraction settings page instead of a hardcoded DAW list.
Added a "Remix" project naming scheme to the create-project wizard.
Extract Metadata is now disabled (with an explanatory tooltip) for DAW types with no extraction support, instead of silently doing nothing.
Extracted project notes from Cubase/Nuendo's Notepad panel.
Added "Launch in DAW" binary configuration for Linux: detects installed DAWs from .desktop files, lets you map a DAW to a binary path, and no longer fails silently when nothing is configured.
Re-enabled Google Drive sync on Linux — it's now gated on actually running inside a Flatpak sandbox, not on Linux itself, so the tarball and AppImage builds get it like every other desktop platform.
Projects can now be linked back to the template they were created from.
Per-DAW mixdown folder names.
Dedicated Language and Theme settings.
New Metadata Extraction settings page.
Added detection support for 13 more DAWs — all 27 supported DAWs now have logos.
Added a Linux build, packaged as a Flatpak for Flathub distribution.
Google Drive sync is intentionally not offered on Linux (the desktop OAuth flow needs a client secret that can't be safely shipped in the public Flathub build)…
Linux notifications now go through xdg-desktop-portal instead of flutter_local_notifications.
